name: Falcon Machine Tools Co., Ltd.
summary: Falcon Machine Tools Co., Ltd. specializes in the manufacturing, processing, and global sale of a wide array of industrial machinery, including grinders, lathes, milling machines, planers, drill presses, and saw machines, among other related products. Its operations are organized into three key segments: Falcon in Taiwan, Chevalier Machinery, Inc., and the Mainland Region. Beyond its core machine tools business, the company also produces and trades computer accessories and various electronic components. Established in 1972 and headquartered in Taichung, Taiwan, it serves markets across Taiwan, the United States, Mainland China, Europe, and other international territories.
